about: Real conversations that went wrong (24 Nov), as evals: a JD that is in a notice's PDF, a source word read as a company, a source the student named that was ignored, the same answer sent twice, one 'no JD' line per role. The data is shaped like the real RISA Labs case (8 roles with no JD on the ERP; notices 1841 and 1860 with a 16-page PDF; the notice text says the JD is attached). Two states: 'before' (the PDF not yet read as a JD: only the notice text says so) and 'after' (the re-scan kept it as a JD and linked it to the 8 roles). Run by tests/js/conversations.test.js through the same rules the page and the function use. Style (24 Nov): where a file is is said as 'the CDC notice PDF (date)' with an Open link, never a notice number; a source named that doesn't have it says so and where it is, in one sentence.
